nodes.title: The lending service opens to members
nodes.body:
## Outcome
Members of every branch can borrow, renew, reserve and return items through the lending
service in place of the paper loan cards.
Accepting this decides: the date the service opens to members.

## Limits
A person closes this once every ticket under it is closed or dropped and the opening
date is announced.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/design.md#scope
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- release-check
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

nodes.title: Every branch catalogue is migrated and signed off
nodes.body:
## Outcome
Each branch's catalogue is in the lending service, and its branch librarian has
confirmed that what the service lists matches the shelves.

## Limits
The sign-off is each branch librarian's; the import itself is each child ticket's.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/migration.md#sign-off
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- import-check
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
All twelve branch librarians have signed off their catalogues.
Checks: `import-check` PASS.

nodes.title: A loan's due date follows the item's loan period
nodes.body:
## Outcome
When an item is borrowed, the loan is due one loan period after today for that item's
type, moved to the next day the lending branch is open.

## Design
Opening days come from the branch calendar, never from a fixed weekday list.
Follow: `lending/calendar.py`, which already answers whether a branch is open on a date.

## Limits
Fines are out of scope.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/design.md#loan-periods
bounds: lending/loans.py, tests/test_loans.py
human-only: no
done-when:
- loans-tests
- lint
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
Due dates now come from the item type's loan period and the branch calendar.
Follow-up: #29, reference items' same-day loans are not in the help pages.
Checks: `loans-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.

nodes.title: The overdue policy is agreed with the library board
nodes.body:
## Outcome
The library board has agreed how many reminders a member receives and when an overdue
item stops further borrowing.
Accepting this decides: the reminder count and the borrowing limit for overdue items.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/policy.md#overdue-items
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- policy-published
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
Agreed at the board meeting: three reminders, and borrowing stops at two overdue items.
Checks: `policy-published` PASS.

nodes.title: Each branch has confirmed its opening hours
nodes.body:
## Outcome
Every branch manager has confirmed the opening hours and closure days the service uses
to set due dates.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/design.md#branch-calendar
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- calendar-check
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
All branch calendars are confirmed through the end of the year.
Checks: `calendar-check` PASS.

nodes.title: Members can download their borrowing history
nodes.body:
## Outcome
A signed-in member can download every loan they have made as a CSV file, with each
item's title, the branch, and the dates it was borrowed and returned.

## Design
The file is built from the loans table and the title alone; no other catalogue field is
exported. Follow: `lending/reports.py` for the streaming CSV writer.

## Limits
Loans older than the retention period in the privacy policy are not included.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/design.md#member-data, docs/policy.md#retention
bounds: lending/history.py, lending/web/account.py, tests/test_history.py
human-only: no
done-when:
- history-tests
- lint
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

nodes.title: A renewal is refused when another member has reserved the item
nodes.body:
## Outcome
A member who asks to renew an item someone else has reserved is told that it is reserved,
and the loan keeps its due date.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/design.md#renewals
bounds: lending/renewals.py, tests/test_renewals.py
human-only: no
done-when:
- renewals-tests
- lint
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
Renewal now checks the item's hold queue before extending a loan.
Checks: `renewals-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.

nodes.title: The notice sender address is verified with the mail provider
nodes.body:
## Outcome
The mail provider accepts mail from the library's notice address, so reminders reach
members' inboxes rather than their spam folders.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/operations.md#mail
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- mail-check
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
The sending domain is verified and a test reminder reached three providers' inboxes.
Checks: `mail-check` PASS.

nodes.body:
## Outcome
The library's data protection officer has approved the privacy notice a member sees
before signing in for the first time.
Accepting this decides: the wording of the notice.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/policy.md#member-data
bounds:
human-only: yes
done-when:
- docs-check
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

nodes.title: Overdue reminders follow the schedule each branch sets
nodes.body:
## Outcome
Each branch can set the days after the due date on which reminders are sent, and a
member receives reminders on exactly those days.

## Design
The schedule is a branch setting whose default is the schedule the board agreed.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->
reads: docs/policy.md#overdue-items, docs/design.md#notices
bounds: lending/reminders.py, lending/settings.py, tests/test_reminders.py
human-only: no
done-when:
- reminders-tests
- lint
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note
Reminder days are a branch setting, defaulting to days 3, 10 and 21.
Checks: `reminders-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.

nodes.title: Members can place a hold on an item that is out on loan
nodes.body:
## Outcome

hold queue.

human-only: no

<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note

Checks: `holds-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.

nodes.title: A returned item with a hold goes to the hold shelf
nodes.body:

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->

human-only: no

- lint

Checks: `returns-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.

nodes.title: A hold not collected in time passes to the next member
nodes.body:

and the member who missed it is told.

<!-- outcomebound:begin id=ticket v=1 -->

- notices-tests
- lint
<!-- outcomebound:end id=ticket -->

## Closing note

Checks: `holds-tests` PASS, `notices-tests` PASS, `lint` PASS.
